summary: Found one behavioral defect in owner discussion refresh: replies authored by the current GitHub user are included in the feedback fingerprint, so publishing a reply makes the discussion appear changed and can mark an otherwise resumable fix batch stale.
checks: Ran `python3 -m unittest tests.test_owner` — 47 tests passed in 9.779 seconds.

findings.title: Own replies falsely mark feedback and batches as changed
findings.evidence: `content = fingerprint(item)` includes every comment, including the current viewer’s. After the owner posts a reply, the next refresh changes this fingerprint, adds the item to `changed`, and marks batches containing it `discussion_stale` (lines 206–207 and 227–228). Resuming such a batch then requires explicit replan even though no incoming feedback changed.
